      "observations": [
        "Full eleven-path historical patch read, including production root/templates, all three component deltas, CSS, Fluent, both Storybook templates, keyboard test and fixture. role=status replaces the incorrect aria-role on the actual outer notification root. A visually clipped instruction span tells users Alt/Option+Shift+the key label. Static markup can support announcement intent; no screen-reader wording or announcement timing is demonstrated here.",
        "The manager checks physical code KeyJ plus Alt/Shift and calls notification.focus(). The notification forwards focus to its nested container, which focuses the actual tabindex=0 inner div. Current full manager/notification/container bodies and template were reconstructed from retained windows plus all missing actual source windows. Notification data can arrive before connection, is stored, then mapped to container attributes after shadow construction; showing waits on NotificationScheduler before inserting/replacing one active notification. The scheduler implementation itself was not newly audited.",
        "Current container inserts its Fluent resource on first construction, connects the shadow root before appending styles/template, and disconnects localization on component removal. Its explicit warning limits translation-affecting reconnection changes. This is a component lifecycle constraint, not proof that reconnect fully retranslates content.",
        "The manager adds keydown on document and removes it from document on normal hide. Its disconnectedCallback instead removes keydown from window; that exact mismatch exists in the original and accepted source. Normal hide also removes the active notification and restores the saved outside focus. Disconnection while displayed is an unresolved static cleanup concern; no stale handler or null-focus exception was reproduced and the current keyboard test does not cover that lifecycle.",
        "Original test synthesizes the shortcut and asserts the outer host is document.activeElement because focus is nested in shadow roots, then hides the notification. Current test dispatches a composed/bubbling KeyboardEvent on manager and asserts the same host; setup resolves scheduler startup delay/active state and adds a later axe mutation watcher. These are synthetic test contracts. Inner shadow activeElements, trusted keyboard layout/modifier delivery, screen readers and live axe results were not exercised.",
        "D225805 full timeline and every actual submitted thread read. Reviewer initially cannot make the printable-key shortcut work, asks for code KeyJ, delegated focus methods, localization disconnect, test cleanup, fixture namespace/stale attributes, a localizer explanation and a specific Fluent term name. Reviewer reports it works beautifully after .code while still requesting remaining changes. Final original source applies delegation, correctly spelled disconnectedCallback, test hide, namespace declarations and the specific term/comment. Modifier API question ends with no reviewer preference, not a demanded API rewrite.",
        "The localization term concern is discussed with uncertainty about physical key labels and translations; final comment explains the key typically producing KeyJ. Translation of the label does not change the handler's physical code. Design reviewer removal says the CSS is not user-facing; that is a review-routing statement, not an accessibility approval. freaktechnik explicitly accepts after updates; suggested per-component focus tests are not assumed implemented merely from final acceptance.",
        "Bug1919103 full0–7 states the user need, navigation/instruction/test/Storybook criteria and earlier chrome aria-live/accesskey blockers, with a potential upstream D224388 fix. Later landing,1927042 regression locator and1936307 ESR uplift are separate reports. Linked upstream implementation and actual assistive-technology outcomes were not verified, and acceptance is not a substitute for those checks."
      ],
